evidence: provider documentation and crit-labs' own source; calls, formats and GPUs are as the providers state them, not measured by crit unless a kernel says so

operations.what: causal attention of query rows (prefill chunk, decode row or a verify's block) over paged KV with grouped query heads, softmax scale and masks
operations.verify: on the target, attend a few query rows over a real prompt's pages with the kernel and with PagedAttentionPlan on the same pages (FP8 pages decoded the same way): within BF16 probability rounding, a decode row equal to the same row inside a verify block when the build needs exactness, and the same bits on a repeat

kernels.call: flashinfer.BatchPrefillWithPagedKVCacheWrapper and BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper (plan once per step's page table, then run); kv_indptr, kv_indices and last_page_len from the StateCache block table
archs: sm_80 and newer (check the release's support matrix)
kernels.shapes: head dims 64, 128 and 256; any page size; grouped query heads

kernels.call: flash_attn_with_kvcache(q, k_cache, v_cache, cache_seqlens=..., block_table=..., causal=True)
kernels.shapes: head dims up to 256; the paged block size a multiple of 256 tokens
